answer: A secure multi-agent economy leverages cryptographic stake-weighting to anchor digital identities, much like a physical wharf secures heavy vessels against an unpredictable gale. By forcing every autonomous node to lock up native collateral to publish a transaction thread, the protocol imposes a prohibitive capital expenditure. An attacker attempting to flood the network with fraudulent identities faces exponential financial draining, as the aggregate cost of capital required to control consensus rapidly exceeds any potential adversarial reward.
